issues.title: Collab working channels - filter on `From` and `Location`
issues.body:
Some users have expressed the wish to be able to filter on the `From` field.  This seems straightforward.

They have also asked to filter on `Location`.  This is more challenging, since it's a comma-separated array of values.

I _guess_ we could handle it by passing an array of strings to the data-table, and the data-table rendering them as comma-separated. But, it would generate the drop-down and perform the filter based upon the arrays of values.

So, the filter on "From" is essential. The filter on "Location" is nice-to-have, please.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/133060754-5d3510f6-77c6-4a90-b6d3-1ff722aa4a65.png)
